complexity.notes: Correctness bug: since strs[i] may contain any of the 256 ASCII characters, the delimiter could appear inside an input string, corrupting the round-trip; a length-prefix scheme (e.g., 'len#string') is the standard robust fix. Also decode(encode([''])) returns ['', ''] instead of [''] because the trailing delimiter plus empty content produces an extra empty segment. Stylistically, 'if strs:' is unnecessary since join handles empty lists, but the empty-list case must still be distinguished from a list of one empty string.
complexity.summary: Encodes by joining all strings with a fixed delimiter (with a trailing delimiter appended) and decodes by splitting on that delimiter. Both operations are linear in the total character volume, which is O(n) given bounded string lengths.
